achievementOrder: On your own turn, optionally discard Tactical Secondary Missions for +1CP

clarifications: A cumulative condition grants VP for both that condition and the normal condition.
Only one of the listed alternatives, or the normal condition, can award VP.
Destroyed, embarked on a Transport, or removed by a rule such as Strategic Reserves.
VP above a stated card limit is ignored.
A Secondary Mission 'When Drawn' section applies only to Tactical Secondary Missions.
faq: End of battle vs fifth round
VP scored at the end of the battle are not subject to the 15VP per-battle-round limit.
Removing an operation marker also removes the status it applied.
A Primary Mission marker can only be removed when that mission specifies how/when; otherwise it cannot be removed.
The terrain area does not need to have been trapped when the enemy unit was destroyed.
An operation marker can be removed after surveilling and the objective can still be achieved in the same turn.
With multiple central objectives, cumulative VP can be scored regardless of which central objective the markers are within, provided those objectives are controlled.
missionSequence: Select one available Force Disposition and record it on the roster.
Use the opponent's Force Disposition symbol to determine the Primary Mission.
Use the A/B/C layout associated with the Primary Mission combination, as directed by the event organiser or randomly determined.
44 x 60 inch battlefield; place terrain according to the selected layout.
Match the layout edges, then roll off; winner decides Attacker and Defender.
Secretly choose Tactical or Fixed; Fixed also chooses two Fixed Missions; reveal decisions.
Record transport embarkations and Strategic Reserves, then reveal.
Alternate setup starting with Defender; Titanic setup skips the player's next setup turn.
Resolve allowed redeploy rules after deployment, alternating from the Attacker.
Roll off; winner takes first turn.
Alternate resolving pre-battle rules, starting with the player taking first turn.
Battle ends after five battle rounds; turns continue even if a player has no models remaining at turn start.
Apply Battle Ready VP, compare totals, and ignore VP over source maximums.
